newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - BOURSE SHOWS POSITIVE NUMBERS DESPITE SLUMP.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - BOURSE SHOWS POSITIVE NUMBERS DESPITE SLUMP.

text.p: Despite recent despondency following an early year surge, not all of the numbers at the Lithuanian stock exchange are negative and the bourse holds some bargains, dealers said on Monday.

"Turnover is quite big," said Tomas Andrejauskas, a broker with Suprema. "You cannot call that a bad market. The market is either bullish or bearish...but there is always quite a lot of business to do."
Although the capitalisation of the Vilnius bourse dropped to 5.621 billion litas last week from 5.726 litas the week before, central market turnover rose to 8.8 million litas from 3.7 million litas.
Numbers for submitted orders, executed orders, supply of shares per week and demand of shares per week also rose last week compared to the previous week.
And with share prices down, now may be the time to jump in, Andrejauskas said.
"That's bad for those who acquired shares at high prices, but it's a good time for new investors to step into the market," Andrejauskas said.
"We think it's time to start to buy," said Grazina Bachiuliene, a broker with Vilfima.
